effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 cards of your deck. Then, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects trashes cards from your deck, delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon.
